page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; no margin notes, no notes below the text. Running head at the top centre. Catchword at the lower right: none visible.

main_text.p: dator, quàm blandus adulator esse videar. Nihil itaque hoc tempore de te dicam, Sulcere, humanissime & eruditissime uir: nihil de D. Vuolfgango Vuissenburgio, theologo ual de eximio, et Academiæ rectore clarissimo: nihil de Martino Borrhao, professore tecu theologiæ dignissimo: nihil de optimo & doctissimo Domino Ioanne Iunio, symmista & colega tuo meritissimo: Marco Berfio, Iacobo Truckenbroto, Conrado Lycosthene amico suauissimo, Huldricho Coccio, Thoma Gyrenfalcko, Ioanne Ibelhardo, Sebastiano Leupusculo, Seuerino Erimontano, Ioanne Maxdero, & Ioanne Brandmillero, aliisq; diuini uerbi ministris, quorum officijs quotidianis afficimur: molestias, quas nō sine labore, aut sine dolore & murmure uestro promptissimè fertis, prætermitto. Hoc tantum dicam, multitudinis atq; magistratuum studia, pro se quidem satis accensa: conciionibus tamen uestris & crebris interpellationibus magis inflammari, ut ferè quicquid ab illis in nos benignitatis profectum est, uestro rogatu & impulsu magna ex parte ortum natumq; uideatur. Sed hic, ut dixi, breuitati studeo: quia ex illis sum qui experiuntur, & in aliena cau sa uersor lubentius. Tiguri & Geneuæ diutius hærebo.
Tigurum enim omnium semper profugorum tegumentum, & doctissimorum Theologorum

page.notes: Heading "PRAEFATIO." is the running head at top. The final line "logorum" is a catchword-like word at the foot right; treated as a line of text. Lines near the foot are partly obscured by show-through and the ink bleed of the damaged lower right corner; "Tigurum... Theologorum" and the last word are uncertain. The line "dator, quàm blandus..." starts a word cut from the previous page ("Sulcere" line etc.). The word at the top-left of the first line is partly lost: "dator" is probably "adulator" split across lines (read as "salutator"-like); marked as uncertain. Several words in the body (Lycosthene, Gyrenfalcko, Erimontano, Maxdero) are read from a weak scan and may contain errors. Show-through of the reverse page is present and excluded.
